Question
========
Explain the following concept, spelling out the acronym first if there is one. Give its definition and its usage, and if it has several usages, its most important one.

**Ring -1**

Solution
========
The privilege level below the kernel, introduced for hardware virtualisation, where the hypervisor runs. It lets a guest kernel keep believing it runs in ring 0 while the hypervisor keeps control.
